pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: The patches exhibit irregular, primarily polygonal geometries with soft, rounded corners and smooth pixel-level edge gradients. The spatial area of the patches is relatively uniform across the lower and mid-flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light-colored pathways form a continuous, high-thickness network separating the patches. Junction nodes are clearly defined as tri-directional intersections with consistent pixel density and connectivity.
